name: ARTROBOT
name_zh: 北京钢铁侠科技有限公司
summary:
ARTROBOT, operated by Beijing Gangtiexia Technology, develops humanoid, wheeled and other legged robots together with motion-control technology. Founded in September 2015, the company combines complete robot design with internally developed components and algorithms. Its humanoid platforms include the ART series, and its engineering work also covers gait controllers and robot joints.

The company serves university laboratories, research and teaching, specialized robotics and energy-safety applications. It offers platforms for experiments in robot control and AI as well as task-oriented systems such as inspection and sorting robots. Its activities span both educational equipment and practical robotic solutions for demanding operating environments.
